name: Still Life x FreeTerraForged Bridge
description: Places Still Life's biomes properly on FreeTerraForged terrain, and makes the ground, rock, snow and plants follow the land: scree below cliffs, regional rock, a snow line by climate with snow where weather would put it, a natural treeline, shores and forest edges; beaches like Still Life's own, wetlands and salt lakes at any height, Still Life's ground kept off cave floors, and gentle terraces instead of FreeTerraForged's coastal uplift cliff. Options in config/stilllife_ftf_bridge.properties, saved per world. Needs FreeTerraForged 1.0.0027 or later and the Still Life FTF edition.
